clean_break.name: CLEAN BREAK
clean_break.verdict: You are off the ship and nothing came with you.
clean_break.how: Reach the shuttle bay with the power banked and fewer than {threshold} infested samples aboard, and launch.

carrier.name: CARRIER
carrier.verdict: You are off the ship. So is it.
carrier.how: Launch holding {threshold} or more infested samples. The run looks won and is not.

scuttle.name: SCUTTLE
scuttle.verdict: You stayed aboard and made sure nothing else left either.
scuttle.how: Arm the overload on the bridge and still be aboard when it reaches critical, {fuse} hours later.

beacon.name: BEACON
beacon.verdict: You did not get off, but the warning did — and so will whoever answers it.
beacon.how: Broadcast from comms, then die or run out of window with no overload armed.

lost.name: LOST
lost.verdict: You did not get off, and nothing left the ship to say what happened.
lost.how: Everything else: the window closes, or something takes the last thing you could still do.
